facts.label: Passado: mensagens de trabalho
facts.sub: Use read, sent, wrote, opened e fixed para contar o que aconteceu. Use didn’t + verbo base para negar. Pergunte Did you get my text? e responda I read it at ten.

facts.label: Mensagens
facts.sub: Para falar de uma mensagem, diga I read it at ten. Se não respondeu, diga I didn’t answer. Dizer o motivo é educado: I was asleep.

facts.label: Resposta
facts.sub: Respostas curtas funcionam bem: Got it, thanks. Para confirmar o horário, diga Tuesday’s meeting is at nine. Evite mensagens longas quando o assunto é simples.

pages.title: A bright office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is nine in the morning in a bright office in Minneapolis. Computers hum, and coffee machines beep. Zoe sits at her desk with a mug. Her boss Kit stops next to her chair. He holds a tablet with a long message. He asks about last night’s text.
“Zoe, did you get my text last night?” says Kit. “Yes, I read it at ten, but I didn’t answer.” says Zoe. “Why not? It was important.” says Kit.
